_comment: APP MODE (plan row 0e, operator 2026-09-25: "Both"). ComfyUI's app view shows a workflow as a form: extra.linearMode opens it that way and extra.linearData.inputs is the form, top to bottom, in exactly this order (the frontend does not sort it). scripts/build_variants.py writes `story_only` onto every per-machine workflow (the card IS the lane: its machine tuning stays hidden) and `advanced` onto workflows/otr_app.json (every picker, in the operator's order). Entries name a node TYPE and a widget; the generator resolves the node id per workflow and refuses a type that is missing or not unique, or a widget that node does not have. The canonical carries neither: it is the workflow the operator edits on the canvas. HAND-ORDERED ON PURPOSE -- the matrix's key_indicators omit the cloud slots and include machine tuning, so a generated list would drop what he named and show what should hide; tests/test_app_mode.py checks no matrix user-choice key is missing from `advanced`.
my_story_note: My Story only: this field and the ones below it (to Music Style) are read only when Source Bank is my_story.
title_note: Optional, any bank: name the episode yourself. Blank lets the writer title it.
source_ref_note: Pins one source inside the bank above (a play, an article). Pick a bank first -- it is refused with the roll.
pickers_note: Every lane is offered. The per-machine workflows pick lanes that fit their card; a heavier pick here can run out of memory.
